set_aside.subject: EDGE_DELIVERY_RULES
set_aside.question: What exact keys, result type and total mapping does `data_provider.EDGE_DELIVERY_RULES` own, and which part of A13 rule 9 remains logic owned by `run_graph`?
options: A total table keyed by source conclusion and guard state, returning the edge delivery state
Only policy constants used by `run_graph`, with `run_graph` implementing the complete derivation
No table; `run_graph` owns the derivation directly
set_aside.default_guess: Make it a total data-provider table keyed by source conclusion plus guard presence/match, with `run_graph` owning its application.
